"Control requirements:
Recipe data should include recipe number, raw material type, raw material ratio, and production temperature."

"1. Commands for opposite movements of the same physical axis must never be energized together. Unless the public task states a priority, inhibit both directions when both commands conflict. This physical-direction rule is separate from mutually exclusive operating modes."

```st
IF deleteRecipe THEN
    ...
ELSIF addRecipe THEN
    ...
ELSIF modifyRecipe THEN
    ...
ELSIF queryRecipe THEN
    ...
END_IF;
```
